settings.title: Why Most Local SEO Stops Working After the First Suburb

settings.html:
You rank in your home suburb but disappear when someone two towns away searches for the exact same thing.

Your Google Business Profile is set up, but your website has one page trying to rank for every area you serve at once.

Your competitors have 20 location pages. You have an "Areas We Serve" list with suburb names and no content behind any of them.

That's the gap we close.

settings.title: What Local SEO From Us Actually Looks Like

settings.html:
Location Page Architecture

One dedicated page per suburb, town or city you serve. Each targets the exact search people use in that area, not a template with the suburb name swapped out.

Local Keyword Research Per Area

We research what people in each area are searching for, including suburb-level and long-tail searches your competitors have missed.

On-Page SEO and Content

Every location page is written with local knowledge, correct heading structure and the right keyword in the H1. No generic filler.

LocalBusiness Schema

Structured data on every page we build, telling Google who you are, where you operate and what you provide.

Citation Building

We submit your business to South African directories (Yellosa, Cylex, Brabys and industry platforms) with your Name, Address and Phone consistent across all of them.

Monthly Local Ranking Reports

We track your local pack and organic positions per suburb, so you see exactly where you are gaining ground.

Google Business Profile management is not included in Local SEO packages. GBP setup and optimisation is available as a once-off add-on at R1,500.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: What is the difference between Local SEO and regular SEO?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Regular SEO targets broad keywords nationally. Local SEO targets location-specific searches like "plumber in Centurion", "dentist near Fourways" or "electrician Midrand", and focuses on the map pack and local organic results. If your customers come from specific areas, local SEO delivers the fastest, most measurable return.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: Do I actually need a dedicated page for every suburb I serve?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Yes, if you want to rank in each one. Google ranks pages, not businesses. To appear when someone in Krugersdorp searches for your service, you need a page that targets Krugersdorp, with localised content, the right keyword in the H1 and schema markup. An "Areas We Serve" list does not rank for anything.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: Is Google Business Profile management included?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: No. GBP setup and optimisation is a once-off add-on at R1,500. Ongoing GBP management is handled separately on request. We are upfront about this because hiding it inside a retainer is one of the oldest tricks in local SEO.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: How many location pages do I need?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Start with the areas that bring in the most revenue. A plumber in Pretoria might start with Centurion, Pretoria East, Pretoria North, Midrand and Soshanguve: five pages, five new ranking opportunities. A few well-built pages always beat many thin ones, and we advise on scope based on your area, competition and budget.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: How long before I start ranking locally?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Low-competition suburbs often move within 6 to 8 weeks of a page being indexed. Competitive areas like Sandton or Pretoria CBD take 3 to 6 months. We track each location separately and report monthly, so you always know where things stand.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: Can location pages be added to my existing website?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Yes. They can be added to any WordPress site without a rebuild. We build them as new pages, connect them to your navigation and internal links, and submit them to Search Console.
